question: Rekha swims in a 40-metre-long pool. She swims from one end to the other and comes back, covering 80 metres in one minute along a straight path. What is her average velocity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0 m/min**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **Average velocity** is defined as the total displacement divided by the total time taken. It is a vector quantity and depends on the net change in position (displacement). 

• In the given scenario, **Rekha swims in a straight path** in a 40-meter-long pool. She swims from one end of the pool to the other and comes back to the starting point. 

• The **total displacement** in this case is 0 meters because Rekha starts and ends at the same point. Displacement is the shortest distance between the initial and final positions, which is zero. 

• The total time taken for the swim is **1 minute**. 

• Using the formula for average velocity: 
 
**Average Velocity = Total Displacement / Total Time**, we get: 
 
**Average Velocity = 0 meters / 1 minute = 0 m/min**. 

• Hence, the average velocity of Rekha is **0 m/min**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 

• **Velocity vs. Speed:** 
 

• **Velocity** is a vector quantity that considers both magnitude and direction, whereas **speed** is a scalar quantity and only takes magnitude into account. 

• In this scenario, while the total distance covered by Rekha is **80 meters**, her displacement is **0 meters**, resulting in a velocity of **0 m/min**. 
 
 

• **Displacement:** 
 

• Displacement is defined as the shortest distance between the initial and final position of an object. 

• In the given scenario, since Rekha returns to her starting point, the displacement is **0 meters**. 
 
 

• **Average Speed:** 
 

• Average speed is calculated as **Total Distance / Total Time**. 

• In this case, Rekha’s total distance is **80 meters**, and the total time is **1 minute**. Thus, her average speed is **80 m/min**. 
 
 

• **Practical Examples:** 
 

• Scenarios where displacement is zero often occur in closed-loop movements, such as running on a circular track or swimming back and forth in a straight pool. 

• In such cases, the average velocity will always be **0** if the starting and ending points are the same. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
 

• **Key Formulae:** 
 

• **Average Velocity = Displacement / Time** 

• **Average Speed = Total Distance / Time** 
 
 

• **Difference Between Displacement and Distance:** 
 

• **Distance** is the total path covered, while **displacement** is the shortest path between two points. 

• In this question, Rekha’s total distance is **80 meters**, but her displacement is **0 meters**. 
 
 

• **Nature of Scalar and Vector Quantities:** 
 

• **Speed** is a scalar quantity because it only considers magnitude. 

• **Velocity** is a vector quantity because it considers both magnitude and direction.
